title: Toward an Atlas of Cultural Commonsense for Machine Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Crowdsourcing commonsense knowledge about six universal life rituals (e.g., weddings, funerals, births) from participants in two distinct national groups (the United States and India) to compare culturally specific practices, event durations, and social roles, aiming to highlight and mitigate Western bias in existing NLP commonsense datasets.
